subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: What identity boundary should iOS enforce for manually entered public WSS domains whose system-trusted leaf certificates legitimately vary across connections?
rationale: The current leaf pin is incompatible with anycast certificate pools, but removing it without a replacement application-identity check changes the protection established by prior iOS TLS hardening.

options.title: Bind gateway identity
options.body: Use normal system TLS for manual public hostnames and additionally verify the paired gateway's durable application identity across reconnects and certificate changes.

options.title: Allow multiple leaf pins
options.body: Persist a bounded user-approved pin set, which reduces immediate loops but remains brittle across provider-wide certificate rotation and requires eviction policy.

options.title: Keep strict leaf pinning
options.body: Document Cloudflare-style anycast TLS as unsupported and preserve the current security model at the cost of blocking this remote connection mode.

recommendation.title: Bind gateway identity
recommendation.body: Use normal system TLS for manual public hostnames and additionally verify the paired gateway's durable application identity across reconnects and certificate changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person with both iOS and security ownership, and their merged history covers the central connection and TLS enforcement path.
